entries.1dfb8dee72980ce3: This is the core business of the group, which consists of the Company and 12 consolidated subsidiaries (as of March 31, 2026), and its main activity is the manufacture and sale of custom-made wigs. The reportable segments are three, which divide hair-related products and services for general customers by customer gender: the "Men's Business," the "Women's Business" and the "Women's Ready-Made Products Business." For custom-made wigs, after the shape of the head is measured at a store with a 3D molding system, manufacturing is outsourced to a manufacturing subsidiary, and the Company purchases the finished products and delivers them through 283 stores in Japan.
entries.3e7d73f53807feb7: This business provides ready-made wigs, other products and services to female customers. The ready-made wigs are manufactured by the group's manufacturing subsidiaries and by contract manufacturers outside the group in Asian countries, and are sold at 91 stores of a separate store format, "Julia Orrège," and 36 stores of NAO-ART. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥6,227 million.
entries.615f290cd7c0deba: This business provides custom-made wigs, other products and services to female customers. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥13,522 million. The flagship salon for women's custom-made wigs, "Grand Salon Ginza," opened in September 2025.
entries.6dc230269e51b137: This business provides custom-made wigs, other products and services to male customers.
entries.767f1b99130b4f39: This is a business segment not included in the reportable segments, and includes manufacturing subsidiaries and others.

entries.a2091b3873816614: This is a business segment not included in the reportable segments, and includes manufacturing subsidiaries and others. In addition to wig manufacturing by AN Philippines and ANMP in the Philippines and ANBD in Bangladesh, it includes AN Tomonokai, a prepaid specified transaction business; Art Mikawaya, which makes wigs for entertainment use; Art Medical, which engages in pharmaceutical sales and medical-related support businesses; and sales subsidiaries in Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,576 million.
